name: anchor_open
blurb: Stationary open partner. Two-state anchor for the exact belief MDP.

name: anchor_closed
blurb: Stationary closed partner. Two-state anchor for the exact belief MDP.

name: handoff_open
blurb: Structured handoff. The task is known and the partner model is open.

name: handoff_closed
blurb: Structured handoff. Commit is unsafe; yield is appropriate.

name: handoff_open_late
blurb: Structured handoff with a longer look before the score window.

name: handoff_closed_late
blurb: Structured handoff. Early cues are easy to over-read.

name: reversal_open_to_closed
blurb: Veridical reversal from open to closed.

name: reversal_open_to_closed_late
blurb: Veridical reversal from open to closed, later in the episode.

name: novel_reversal_after_gap
blurb: Unrelated intervening trials, then a novel closed-to-open reversal.

name: novel_reversal_after_gap_b
blurb: Second seed of the novel reversal after a gap.

name: true_belief_control
blurb: True-belief control. Public cues and private evidence agree.

name: false_belief_private
blurb: Public cues say go. A private channel reveals that the world is closed.

name: false_belief_no_access
blurb: No perceptual access. The public cue follows a false partner belief.

name: whose_belief
blurb: The question is what the partner believes, not what is true of the world.

name: held_out_deceptive
blurb: Held-out partner. Public cues say go, and commit is unsafe.
